title: 6.0 retro ship-review follow-ups (release resumability, semver, deploy ledger durability)
summary: Deferred findings from the retro ship reviews of NUHT-012, 014, 022 and 027: 012#3 dirty-run evidence binds only to the parent; 014#2 a failed gh release after a successful push is not resumable; 014#3 the release job does not run tests/unit; 014#4 a multiline BREAKING CHANGE paragraph followed by trailers; 022#3 a scaffolded workflow with no check commands passes; 027#2 union-merged deploy ledger order; 027#3 unlocked read-modify-write in deploy record; 027#4 record written before the ledger append, unchecked short write; 027#5 ledger read errors not shown in the viewer.
